title: ZX Bank Ltd. – Personal Loan Information

nodes.title: Features & Benefits
nodes.summary: Personal loans up to ₹30,00,000 (INR) or equivalent in local currency, flexible tenure of 12–60 months, quick approval with instant eligibility check and digital application, zero collateral (no security or guarantor), and part-payment and foreclosure options.

nodes.title: Interest Rate
nodes.summary: Interest rates per annum: salaried customers in India/Sri Lanka 11.75%–17.99%, self-employed (India/Sri Lanka) 13.25%–19.99%, and Bangladesh/Bhutan/Nepal 13.50%–21.00% (subject to local market review and branch/country variation).

nodes.title: Documentation Required
nodes.summary: Salaried applicants: application form, photo ID (Aadhaar/Passport/Voter ID), address proof, latest 3 months' salary slips, last 6 months' bank statements, one passport-size photograph, and PAN (Indian). Self-employed applicants additionally need last 2 years' Income Tax Returns and business continuity proof (trade license, GST certificate, etc.).

nodes.title: Maximum Loan Amount
nodes.summary: Maximum loan amounts by country: India ₹30,00,000, Sri Lanka LKR 60,00,000, Bangladesh BDT 35,00,000, Bhutan BTN 15,00,000, Nepal NPR 40,00,000. Final amount and eligibility depend on bank policy, applicant profile, and credit assessment.

nodes.title: How to Apply
nodes.summary: Apply by visiting any ZX Bank branch, online through the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App or NetBanking, or by calling 24x7 Customer Care or using the AI assistant 'Zia' on the app. More details at www.zxbank.asia/personal-loan. Terms are subject to change per regulatory guidelines.
